capabilities: Generate blog posts from notes via the OpenAI API
Process and convert images embedded in notes
Customize generation prompts and API settings
Choose the output language (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean)
extras: Output is saved as a new Markdown file in the vault; README warns image processing can be slow and content should be reviewed before generation. Supports a custom API endpoint.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note into a polished, publish-ready blog post.
summary: AI plugin that turns an Obsidian note into a formatted blog post using the OpenAI API, handling images and multiple languages.
